error.approval_hash_mismatch: The draft files changed after the hash was frozen; the approval was withdrawn. Prepare the draft again.
error.approval_required: There is no valid approval for this draft.
error.cap_exceeded: The daily or per-host cap is reached.
error.company_confirmation_failed: The typed company name does not match.
error.compliance_blocked: A compliance gate (robots.txt or the provider terms review) refuses this step. Review the provider terms in Settings or try again later.
error.cover_stale: The cover letter does not match this send: its date is not today, its company or role differs from the posting, or it still carries a placeholder; the live approval is refused.
error.csrf_failed: The form expired; reload and try again.
error.duplicate_company: An application to the same company already exists inside the re-application window. Start it with an explicit override reason if it is deliberate.
error.gate_regressed: A hard gate that passed at shortlist time now fails (blocked company, salary floor, region or onsite city); the live approval is refused.
error.gate_undetermined: The hard gates could not be re-evaluated (rules or overlay unreadable); the live approval is refused.
error.illegal_transition: That is not possible in the current state.
error.lang_unavailable: That language is not translated yet and cannot be selected.
error.manual_only: This posting applies by e-mail (mailto:). No mail path exists, so it is manual-only and cannot be approved for hand-off.
error.merge_blocked: A keep-apart decision or an apply lock on both positions forbids this merge.
error.overlay_absent: The private overlay is not present, so a live approval is refused.
error.passkey_limit: The maximum number of passkeys (8) is already registered; remove one before adding another.
error.position_busy: An application on this position is approved for live sending; merge and split are refused until it is finished or withdrawn.
error.posting_closed: The posting is closed or expired; the live approval is refused.
error.posting_risk: This posting carries a hard scam-risk flag (asks for money, identity documents or bank data). Live approval is refused.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests; wait and retry.
error.registration_rejected: The passkey registration was rejected. Try again.
error.report_required: The approval report was not shown for this draft. Reload the page and approve again.
error.area_confirmation_required: The CV area overlap was not confirmed. Tick the confirmation and approve again.
error.slot_missing: No template exists for this area and language.
error.step_up_required: Verify with your passkey first (it must be newer than five minutes).
error.templates_stale: The template set is too old, was built from a different overlay or carries no passing gate stamp; the live approval is refused. Rebuild the set.
error.title: The action was refused
error.upload_refused: A draft file exceeds the upload limits of this provider (file type, size, number of files or characters), so it cannot be approved. Replace the file and prepare the draft again.
